verdict.rationale: Orrick stores client data through Orrick Connect (extranets, deal rooms, file sharing, client portals), so letting users choose a storage region is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents any way to choose a storage region or residency. The ISO/IEC 27001 certification and the Privacy-in-a-Box and Cyber, Privacy & Data Innovation legal advisory services are adjacent topics, not a residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
